福爾摩沙小導遊臺南 Tainan・安平區

安平開台天后宮Anping Kai-Tai Mazu Temple

大考前你可能會去廟裡求好運。要攻打一座島之前，鄭成功也一樣。他到福建湄洲，恭迎三尊海上女神媽祖的神像上船隨行。相傳 1661 年，正是媽祖引領他的船隊順利登陸。據廟方沿革，1668 年鄭成功之子在安平渡口（今石門國小）建廟奉祀媽祖。1895 年乙未之役安平受到嚴重破壞，廟後來遷到現址；1966 年正殿完工，1994 年全部完成。前方的牌樓是一條界線：那邊是世俗，這邊是神聖。看到石鼓上的螺旋了嗎？那是椒圖，龍王害羞的小兒子。這是官廟，大門用門釘而不畫門神。從龍門進、虎門出。殿內，左邊是五水仙（河神），右邊是四海龍王。仔細看：這裡的媽祖是軟身神像，四肢關節可以活動。

Before a big exam, you might visit a temple for luck. Before invading an island, Koxinga did the same. He sailed to Meizhou in Fujian and brought three statues of Mazu, the goddess of the sea, aboard his fleet. It is said that Mazu herself guided his ships ashore in 1661. According to the temple's records, in 1668 Koxinga's son built a temple for her at Anping's ferry port, where Shimen Elementary School stands today. Anping suffered great damage in the war of 1895, and the temple was later moved. The main hall was finished in 1966, and all the work was done in 1994. The archway out front is a boundary line: on that side, the everyday world; on this side, sacred ground. See the spiral on the stone drum? That's Jiaotu, the shy youngest son of the Dragon King. This was an official temple, so the gates carry door studs instead of painted door gods. Enter through the dragon door, and exit through the tiger door. Inside, five river gods attend Mazu on the left, and the four Dragon Kings of the seas on the right. Look closely: the Mazu statues are jointed statues, with movable limbs.

一分鐘看懂

One-minute intro

為什麼值得來

Why it matters & history

安平開台天后宮與鄭成功渡海來台的故事緊緊相連，據廟方沿革是台灣早期的媽祖廟之一。廟裡的媽祖是四肢可動的軟身神像，陪祀五水仙與四海龍王，是認識海港信仰的地方。

Anping's Kai-Tai Mazu Temple is tied to Koxinga's crossing to Taiwan and, by the temple's own history, is one of Taiwan's early Mazu temples. Its Mazu statues have movable joints, and the river gods and dragon kings stand beside her.

  1. 1661（相傳 legend）鄭成功迎三尊湄洲媽祖隨船隊渡海，相傳媽祖引領船隊順利登陸。Koxinga brings three Mazu statues across the strait; legend says she guided his fleet ashore.
  2. 1668（廟方沿革）鄭成功之子在安平渡口建廟奉祀媽祖。According to the temple, Koxinga's son builds a Mazu temple at the Anping ferry landing.
  3. 1895乙未之役安平受到嚴重破壞，廟後來遷到現址。Anping is badly damaged in the 1895 war, and the temple later moves to its present site.
  4. 1966–1994正殿 1966 年完工，1994 年全部完成。The main hall is finished in 1966 and the whole temple in 1994.

認識景點

About the place

媽祖，海上女神：漁民向媽祖祈求出海平安、漁貨豐收。 艦隊、船隊：一起航行的一群船。鄭成功的艦隊載著三尊媽祖。 沙洲：海裡的沙堆，船可能會在上面擱淺。 天上聖母：媽祖的另一個稱號。Sylvia 把祂比喻成聖母瑪麗亞。

Mazu, goddess of the sea: Fishing communities pray to Mazu for safe voyages and good catches. fleet: A group of ships sailing together. Koxinga's fleet carried three Mazu statues. sandbar: A hidden ridge of sand in the sea. Ships can run aground on it. Holy Mother of Heaven: Another name for Mazu. Sylvia compares her to the Virgin Mary.

官廟：由當時的官方設立的廟。這座廟建於 1668 年。 牌樓：分隔世俗與神聖的門樓。 石獅（公獅與母獅）：一對石獅守護著廟門。 石鼓：螺旋是椒圖，龍王害羞的小兒子。

official temple: A temple set up by the rulers of the time. This one was built in 1668. archway (pailou): A gate that marks the line between the everyday world and sacred ground. lion and lioness: A pair of stone lions guards the temple door. stone drum: The spiral is Jiaotu, the shy youngest son of the Dragon King.

門釘：大門上圓圓的門釘。官廟用門釘，不畫門神。 龍門／虎門：從龍門進討吉利，從虎門出解厄運。 五水仙（河神）：五水仙在媽祖的左邊陪祀。 四海龍王：在媽祖的右邊陪祀。

door stud: Round metal studs on the gate. Official temples have them instead of painted door gods. dragon door / tiger door: Enter through the dragon door for good luck, and exit through the tiger door. river gods: Five river gods attend Mazu on the left. the four Dragon Kings: The Dragon Kings of the four seas attend Mazu on the right.

軟身神像：四肢關節可以活動的神像。 保平安的手鍊：。佛珠一般有十八顆。

jointed statue: A statue whose arms and legs have joints that can move. blessing bracelet: A bracelet worn for protection. Buddhist ones usually have eighteen beads.

實景照片

Photos on site

廟前牌樓 The Archway

天后宮前廣場上的大牌樓，橘色的屋頂上站滿彩色的龍和裝飾。牌樓是一條界線：走過它，就來到神明的地方。

This big archway stands on the square in front of the temple. Colorful dragons and decorations stand on its orange roofs. The archway is a boundary line: walk through it, and you are on sacred ground.

天后宮全景 The Whole Temple

從正面看整座天后宮：中間是正殿，左右兩座樓，一座是鐘樓，一座是鼓樓。廟方資料說，鐘鼓樓是1973年增建的。

This is the whole temple from the front. The main hall stands in the middle. The two towers on the sides are the bell tower and the drum tower. The temple says they were added in 1973.

正殿正面 Front of the Main Hall

門口上方的紅色橫幅寫著「天上聖母」，這是媽祖的稱號。門邊有雕著龍的石柱。上方的匾額「聖母安瀾」，是祈求媽祖讓海浪平靜、船隻平安。

The red banner over the door says "Holy Mother of Heaven," another name for Mazu. Stone columns carved with dragons stand by the door. The plaque above asks the Holy Mother to calm the waves, so ships can sail safely.

天后宮正殿屋頂 Main Hall Roof

綠色琉璃瓦雙層屋頂，中間的匾額「聖母安瀾」意思是「媽祖讓海浪平靜」，兩側是鐘鼓樓。廟方說這是臺灣本島最早的媽祖廟，媽祖神像在1661年隨鄭成功的船隊來到臺灣。

This double roof has green glazed tiles. The plaque says, "Holy Mother Calms the Waves." Bell and drum towers stand on both sides. The temple says it is the oldest Mazu temple on Taiwan's main island, and that its Mazu statue came with Koxinga's fleet in 1661.

屋脊剪黏 Cut-Porcelain Ridge

屋脊上的「剪黏」：工匠把彩色瓷片剪成小塊，黏成龍和人物。正中有三位人物，兩邊有龍。

The roof ridge is decorated with cut porcelain. Artisans cut colorful pieces of porcelain and pasted them into dragons and figures. Three figures stand in the middle, with dragons on both sides.

門口的石獅 The Stone Lioness

廟門口的石獅子。仔細看，牠的腳下護著一隻小獅子，所以這是母獅。石獅通常一公一母，成對守護廟門。

Look at this stone lion by the temple door. A little lion cub plays under her paw, so she is the lioness. Stone lions usually come in pairs, a lion and a lioness, to guard the door.

神龕裡的媽祖 Mazu Statues on the Altar

神龕裡坐著許多尊媽祖神像，戴著垂下珠串的帽冠，披著紅色彩帶，前面擺著水果供品。相傳最早的三尊媽祖，是隨鄭成功的船隊來到臺灣的。

Many Mazu statues sit on the altar. They wear crowns with hanging beads and red sashes, and fruit offerings sit in front of them. It is said that the first three Mazu statues came to Taiwan with Koxinga's fleet.
